profile.headline: Sr. Staff Engineer at BreachRx
profile.summary: Polyglot server-side software developer with 25+ years of development experience, including extensive experience with microservices, AWS, serverless, NoSQL and leading engineering teams.  Interests include AI, machine learning, neuroscience, bioinformatics, alternative transportation and working with Spanish-speaking clients/developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Independent Contractor
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- worked on a two-person development team for an early stage start-up doing full-stack greenfield development of a coffee trader management application with various features including price broadcasting, buy/sell offer negotiations, whatsapp bot, price calculation and position management
- design and development of a continuously-deployed AWS serverless application with AWS Lambda / Node / Typescript / DynamoDB / AWS Cognito / SST / Svelte / SvelteKit / CircleCI
- helped educate the rest of the company on engineering best practices as well as assisted in determining the direction of the product with the aid of contextual inquiry of customers in Colombia

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- led a platform team of 6 software developers which was responsible for building out a new microservices architecture to replace existing functionality in a large monolith auto repair management system and educating rest of 50-person engineering team on new direction
- oversaw design and development of various serverless microservices (AWS Lambda / Node / DynamoDB / GraphQL / SST) including individual contributions to an Authentication Service (AWS Cognito)
- helped build out various devops infrastructure including a continuous deployment pipeline (CircleCI), a monorepo for all microservices (pnpm) and a Provision Service for automatically provisioning AWS accounts which spun up dynamically for various use cases (review apps, automated functional testing, adhoc environments)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer / President
positions.description:
Software consulting services specializing in:

- Server-side software development (Javascript/Node/Python/Java)
- API's and REST microservices
- Serverless development (AWS Lambdas)
- Continous delivery/deployment
- Leading Agile engineering teams
- Developing scientific applications for biologists
- Machine Learning and Data Analysis
- Working with Spanish-speaking developers/customers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Digital Labs Immersive Learning Center
- greenfield design and development of iQuatic Shrimp Farm Management system which consists of various microservices (AWS Lambda / Node / DynamoDB), Analysis Dashboard Web Application (Javascript/Svelte) and native mobile app (React Native / Expo)
- for initial release, worked on a two person full-stack team where I was intimately involved with all aspects of the application development process and wore many hats (Front-End/Back-End Development, Architect, Devops, QA, Product Management)
- as product and team grew, took on more of a leadership role to direct and coordinate efforts of a 15-person development team spread across 3 locations in 3 different countries
- developed proprietary localization framework to localize product in various languages
- set up Continuous Deployment pipeline and actively worked with Spanish-speaking beta customers to collect feedback and drive the development of the application
- implemented various data analysis features including machine learning models using AWS Sagemaker to predict various shrimp farm metrics

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Commerce Order Payments
- design and development of Order Graph application which consumes order events from back-end fulfillment system, persists snapshot of orders in Cassandra data store, and provides REST endpoints and topic exchange feed (Rabbit MQ) for dotcom consumers interested in order events which occur after order placement
- provide technical leadership as lead engineer on Order Graph team
- worked on conversion project to move critical piece of order processing out of legacy monolithic commerce application (Java) and into Commerce Order Payments application (Groovy)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ecommerce Platform
- led a team of 8 engineers responsible for designing, building and maintaining a RESTful microservices architecture for an e-commerce application
- helped build a platform framework to facilitate standardized Java microservice development across E-commerce tribe. included components for automated functional testing (Spock/Docker), monitoring (Datadog), configuration management (Zookeeper, Archaius), fault tolerance (Hystrix), container management (Springboot), automated load testing (Jmeter/Soasta), persistence (Riak), authentication (Redis)
- worked on various services including Notification Service (for sending SMS messages to mobile devices), Cart Service (eCommerce Shopping Cart), Order Service, Customer Service, Phone Verification Service (identity verification)
- served as an advocate for agile concepts such as automated functional testing, continuous deployment, iterative development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Subscriptions
Responsibilities Include:  design and development of recurring and usage-based billing products using Activiti, Camel, Cassandra, and legacy Java e-commerce application, decouple Java subscriptions engine from global commerce engine and build new subscriptions RESTful service, help team transition to agile, test-driven development and pair programming, implement GitHub development workflow with continuous integration (Jenkins), write Geb functional tests and help drive development of automated functional test framework

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Anti-spam Engineering
Responsibilities Included: design and development of RESTful Java web application which allows anti-spam clients to test message spools against a dynamic set of spam rules by communicating with back-end hadoop cluster which runs map-reduce and invokes CPU-intensive third party library on Linux slaves, helped perl team transition to Java by setting up infrastructure (Spring, Maven, Tomcat, continuous integration) and mentoring junior engineers, served as agile coach and helped team transition to scrum

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
Scene7 Image Server
Responsibilities Included: design and development of various features for Scene7 dynamic imaging server, worked primarily on Platform Server, a Java web application which translates HTTP request into a set of imaging operations, various feature work on catalog access, request parsing, request processing and optimization, request tracking, and protocol specification, built various components to monitor and aggregate data from hundreds of SaaS hosted image servers deployed across five international data centers. technologies include: Java, Tomcat, Linux, Spring, JMX, MySQL, Hibernate, Web Services

positions.title: Teaching Associate
positions.description:
Department of Computer Science
Responsibilities Included: weekly lecture on introductory programming topics (C/C++/Java), prepare and present lab assignments, assist students in completion of lab, office hours, tutorials on object-oriented programming and compiler/interpreter/debugger assignments, design and development of an instructional Java Swing GUI application which visualizes environment and runtime stacks during execution of a bytecode file by interpreter/debugger

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Media Publisher Application
Responsibilities Included: design, implement, and maintain an automated Java test harness for functional and regression testing of a streaming media and content management enterprise application, modify build scripts and fix installer bugs (Ant, shell scripting, InstallAnywhere, Perl), troubleshoot bug reports, fix bugs in file upload application (Java Swing), write Java reporting framework for defect management system, maintain SOAP test harness written in Java, write test cases for all modules

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
GenView Element Management System
Responsibilities Included: fix various bugs in Java Swing GUI layer of telecommunications network management system (Solaris server and Solaris/Windows client) providing Voice Over IP/ATM, convert storage of user preferences from object serialization to XML, lead design review and implement improvements to server/client installation (InstallAnywhere, Perl, shell scripting, and Java), implement context-sensitive help throughout the application, test weekly builds and investigate problem reports

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Bioinformatics Project in Dr. Nigel Atkinson's Lab
Responsibilities Included: develop Java Swing GUI to display and manipulate DNA sequence alignments (deployed on Linux/Mac), develop Java implementations of several dynamic programming algorithms to identify conserved regions across related species, develop search algorithms which incorporate transcription factor density, gene function, and other biologically relevant criteria

positions.title: Java Test Engineer
positions.description:
Hardware System Console (HSC) Project
Responsibilities Included: test server and partition management software written in Java and deployed in a Linux environment, log and track defects, troubleshoot Linux and application installations on lab machines, write Linux shell scripts for automated testing and installation, develop test plan for service component which uses Resource Manager as communication between AIX partition detected hardware errors and Java application (HSC) running on Linux

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Java DataExpress Project
Responsibilities Included: design and develop a file transfer management system which conforms to the Enterprise Java Beans specification, develop Java Swing GUI prototype, develop servlet and XML document standard as interface between client and application server, write functional specifications from business requirements, fix outstanding defects, assist in development of data model, design and develop a variety of session and entity beans, including a messaging scheme to persist the data from broadcast JMS messages, conform and transfer project to the EJB 1.1 specification and the Weblogic deployment descriptor standards, configure Weblogic and modify/re-write existing development scripts (Linux/NT) to support new application server

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Responsibilities Included: technical support for beta and production releases of on-line advertising account manager and messaging system, write user manual for beta release, extensive QA / testing of Swing GUI, write test cases for all modules, defect tracking, work closely with developers to troubleshoot problems and verify fixes, develop java performance test drivers which measure the accuracy and efficiency of a variety of  SQL queries through a JDBC connection, internal product training, set up technical support and QA infrastructure, implement, customize, and maintain Customer Relationship Management Software (Vantive Sales, Support and Quality applications) through the use of transact-SQL, stored procedures, and Visual Basic
